scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.ci:gate: pnpm exec tsc -p lib/db && pnpm -C artifacts/api-server run build && node scripts/verify-production-schema.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-committed-prosan-dist.mjs
scripts.ci:deploy: node scripts/verify-production-env.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -p lib/db && pnpm -C artifacts/api-server run build && node scripts/verify-production-schema.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-committed-prosan-dist.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
